title: Cross-Functional Collaboration
question: Tell me about a project where you partnered closely with non-engineering stakeholders (e.g. Product, Design, or QA). How did you ensure alignment?

rubric.name: situation_context
rubric.description: Explains team structure, goal, and varied domain perspectives.

rubric.name: bridging_communication
rubric.description: Translates complex technical details into clear non-technical business concepts.

rubric.name: collaborative_action
rubric.description: Describes co-designing solutions, establishing feedback loops, and balancing priorities.

rubric.name: project_outcome
rubric.description: Achieves shared business goals and successful product feature launch.

rubric.name: reflection
rubric.description: Reflects on building empathy across functional disciplines.

expected_signals: Adapts communication style depending on stakeholder background
Explains technical constraints without being dismissive
Establishes clear contracts and review checkpoints
red_flags: Uses dense jargon to baffle non-technical partners
Views product or design input as interference
Works in a silo until final release
follow_up_prompts: How did you explain a hard technical constraint to product managers when they asked for an infeasible deadline?
How did you validate that non-technical partners truly understood the trade-offs?
